question: Can the product resume an interrupted approved render job by executing only the first unfinished immutable stage, then make a completed resume a zero-render no-op, while stale, forged and out-of-budget state rejects before any render call?

productIncrement.goal: A visible Resume Next Approved Stage control backed by a product-owned immutable-stage planner, not an external runner convention.
requiredCapabilities: A v0.2 approved job binds an exact validity window, maximum two render calls, maximum 83886080 artifact bytes and immutable PREVIEW then FINAL order.
Resume planning verifies the manifest, source, completed stage receipts and artifact hashes before selecting the first unfinished stage.
A valid PREVIEW receipt makes resume select FINAL without rerendering PREVIEW; valid PREVIEW and FINAL receipts make resume COMPLETE with zero render calls.
The visible Film workspace exposes resume status, next stage, completed stages and last decision hash.
Stale authorization, forged completed-stage receipt and zero remaining render budget reject before bpy.ops.render.render.

formalSequence.controlledInterruption: after fsynced PREVIEW artifact, stage receipt and resume-decision receipt

negativeControls.mutation: self-valid manifest with validUntil before the observation time
PREVIEW receipt content differs from its declared self hash

required: four process receipts and eight exclusive logs
stale, forged and out-of-budget failure receipts

acceptance: The three-path product patch stays within 500 added lines and builds cleanly from full-history film-engine main.
Start 1 exits 75 only after one PREVIEW render and fsynced immutable receipts; start 2 executes FINAL only and preserves PREVIEW byte-for-byte.
Start 3 returns COMPLETE with zero render calls and preserves both artifacts and receipts byte-for-byte.
Start 4 proves all three attacks reject before a render call and independently decodes the accepted pixels/passes without importing the product module.
Exactly one clean build, four product starts and two render calls occur; source, official configuration, roots and resources satisfy all frozen bounds.
stopRules: Do not mutate PB.1, PB.3 or PB.4 retained roots.
Any source path outside the three allowed Python paths, any C/C++ path or more than 500 added lines stops before build.
Do not begin the clean build unless current free bytes exceed the 100 GiB reserve plus the full 12 GiB PB.5 projection.
Any source, manifest, completed-stage receipt, artifact, binary, OCIO or root mismatch stops before another render call.
Do not weaken timing, budget, stage-order, pixel/pass, negative-control or resource thresholds after observing output.
Do not begin PB.6, force-push, create another ref/tag/release, upload LFS, sign, notarize or distribute a binary.
